title: Stop building the logo. Ship the ugly version tonight.
caption: Stop building the logo. Ship the ugly version tonight. Save this if you keep polishing instead of publishing.

scenes.text:
You do not
have a brand yet.
scenes.voice: You do not have a brand yet.

scenes.text:
One real user beats
a perfect palette.
scenes.voice: One real user beats a perfect color palette.

scenes.sub: No new tools. No new tabs.
scenes.voice: Set a 3 hour timer. No new tools. No new tabs.

scenes.text:
Put it where one
person can use it.
scenes.voice: Put it where one person can actually use it.
Ask one question. Would you pay for this?

scenes.text:
Hesitation is data.
Yes is a business.
scenes.voice: If they hesitate, you learned something. If they say yes, you have a business.

scenes.sub: Watch it again. Then start the timer.
scenes.voice: Save this. Make the ugly thing today. Watch it again, then start the timer.
